answer.text: Last week, the museum changed its opening hours, and the class has been waiting for a new date since then. According to the museum website, the visit will be on 12 June, and Ms Lee says 24 children will come. We have two options. The train costs £6 a child, but only if we book before Tuesday. The bus costs £9 a child, and it is easier. If the booking is late, we will use the bus. Carlos is responsible for the booking, and he will do it by Tuesday. Sara will tell the families, and on Thursday Tom will count the permission forms. Final revision: I changed soon to by Tuesday, so the deadline is exact.
